description: dryvist/.github shareable Renovate preset — the org-wide entry point every dryvist/JacobPEvans repo inherits via `extends: ["local>dryvist/.github"]` (or `github>dryvist/.github`). Renovate resolves a bare repo reference to this `default.json`, so a one-line consumer gets config:recommended plus dryvist's full master policy. This file exists so consumers no longer hit the deprecated `renovate.json`-as-preset fallback.

dryvist/.github is the MASTER source of truth: it extends no other repository's config. This repo's OWN self-config lives in renovate.json (which consumes this file); all policy (auto-merge, trusted orgs, stability, grouping, custom managers) lives in renovate-presets.json + renovate-grouping.json. Nix repos extend the renovate-nix.json variant to opt in to Renovate's native nix manager.
